notes.title: Policy Changes For Free Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/04e01f130a8599d0f70684fc6a79f864b017f9a3.png[/img]

Greetings from PsychoFlux Entertainment!

We're going to talk about the change of our pricing policy, for most of the free games we're servicing.

We have been servicing a lot of free games by offering main game for free, with an $1 empty DLC for donations; so the users who are satisfied by the game are able to support us and the developers by purchasing the DLC, which also makes the game stay in your Steam library.

However, some of the players told us that the game won't stay in their library even after purchasing the DLC, so they had to visit the store page to install it again. Thus we're going to make some changes to solve this problem and give some advantages to the purchasers.

—

[h1]Steam Edition[/h1]
Free games will be switched to Steam Edition, which will cost about $1. [b]If you already purchased the Donationware DLC, you will automatically receive the Steam Edition of the game.[/b]

Also, games that support a leaderboard will also start to support Steam Leaderboard, so you can upload your score at both of them. Steam Cloud and Steam Achievements will be the same as before. We're planning to update the games that are not supporting these features, so please allow us some time.

And maybe we might add Steam Trading Cards, too!


[h1]New Free Version[/h1]
An alternative free version will be added on Steam to compensate former version. Download button will be displayed on the store page, along with the purchase button for the Steam Edition. This new free version won't support any Steamworks features such as Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Leaderboard, etc.

Achievements that you already unlocked won't go away, but you won't be able to unlock new ones. Your score will only be uploaded on the default leaderboard.


[h1]Donationware DLC[/h1]
These DLCs will be gone from the store. As we mentioned, holder of these DLCs will automatically receive the Steam Edition game.

—

These changes will be applied within a day or two, to the games listed below. Please leave your comments if you have any questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/502130/Ctrl_CV/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/735570/Project_Rhombus/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/739260/Golden_Hornet/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/891130/SUPER_FLAIL/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906390/Return/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978790/Frantic_Dimension/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978800/Rolling_Bird/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/983990/Steel_Alcimus/

notes.title: 1.8.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where restarting the game would prevent you from registering scores on the leaderboard.
[*] The leaderboard now displays up to 100th place.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.6 Patch Note
notes.content: New online leaderboard has been implemented. Ranks now show up to 50th place, and the time it takes for scores to be placed on leaderboard is greatly reduced.

notes.title: 1.8.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]If you go back to the door where the main character appears in the first area, you can warp the area. Warp zone will be activated after you reach area 3 at least once.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34091026/54efcc864a8fa0a02e395899ace0035988bd202f.png[/img]

[*]The further you proceed, the shorter the time limit and the faster the drones appear. If you're the one who prefers to wait until the enemy comes to you, it will be harder to survive.

[*]The leaderboard has been initialized due to gameplay changes.[/list]

[i]Special thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CsETplQl7hk]Sonycast_[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1_rOLJVylM]Naseong Kim[/url] for playing[/i]

notes.title: 1.8.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where enemy Bombers won't be killed by the grenades' fragments.
[*]Some tiles and sprites has been modified.
[*]Enemy Elites' AI has been enhanced while they're taking cover behind the boxes.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.3 Patch Note
notes.content: Achievement goal of the 'Risky Rain' has been reduced(1000→600).

notes.title: 1.8.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Vsync option has been added to the settings.
[*]Now you can turn the background music on or off in the settings.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.1 Patch Note
notes.content: Now the game has background music.

notes.title: 1.8.0 Patch Notes (Feb. 12th, 2019)
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the screen vibrates if you face the opposite direction while jumping towards the wall.
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies sometimes didn't move upstairs or downstairs.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now the enemy bullets won't be covered by the player's bullets.
[*]Now the enemy Elite won't be spawned on the starting point.
[*]New achievement 'Blind Blast' has been added.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where grenades falling from the upper floors passed through the ground.
[*]The position where the player character stands on the title screen has been changed.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed some minor issues in enemy AI.
[*]Slightly increased the height of the long box.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now the enemies won't be spawned from the door that are overlapped with the player charcter or right above the player character.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34091026/c33fb171fad12a3bf9ae4ecaaf3e4ed63299cb3a.png[/img]
[*]Now the enemy Scouts with pistols will be spawned in area 4 or later.
[*]The number of enemies coming out of the green room(area 3, 7, 11, ...) has been reduced.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.5 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed a critical error that occurred when you reach area 9.

notes.title: 1.7.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now only a maximum of 2 enemies will come out of the green door(was maximum of 3).
[*]Now the enemy Guards, Bombers, and Elites won't always jump on the box.
[*]By improving collision detection of the scaffolds, problem has been fixed where you would sometimes land on the scaffold again instead of jumping down.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.3 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where Steam's screenshot capture function(F12) didn't work.

notes.title: 1.7.1 & 1.7.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]1.7.1[/h1]
Restart option has been added to the in-game menu that pops up when you pause the game.

[h1]1.7.2[/h1]
A situation where two or more enemies are spawned in exactly the same place will no longer occur.

notes.title: 1.7.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now in area 3 or later, enemy Bombers can throw grenades farther.
[*]Now if you clear the area with your kevlar on, you'll get extra kevlar on the next area.
[*]Fixed an issue where you couldn't hit your enemy when you shot a gun close to the wall.
[*]Now if you press and hold Down key when you're in the air, you can sit down right when you land on the ground.
[*]The speed of bullets shot by enemies has increased, so that you can easily avoid enemy bullets by jumping.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.0 & 1.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]1.6.0[/h1]
[list][*]Time limit per stage has been increased from 120 seconds to 150 seconds.
[*]Some random values has been adjusted to prevent the game from generating situations that are impossible to break through.
[*]Now the enemy's grenades can kill other enemies except those who threw it.
[*]The color of the bullets fired by enemies has been changed.
[*]Now you can reset the controls by pressing Esc key on the title screen.[/list]

[h1]1.6.1[/h1]
[list][*]Now you can control your character with the analogue stick on your controller.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Steam Achievements has been added.
[*]Addressed some issues that are not worth mentioning.[/list]
